description: Create a GitHub issue titled 'Alert: Riot API key expired' with 'urgent' label containing manual instructions for the developer, and create a PR that documents the API key test result. The API route code already handles 401/403 with a user-friendly 503 message, so no code changes are needed.
steps: Test the Riot API by making an HTTP request to https://americas.api.riotgames.com/riot/account/v1/accounts/by-riot-id/Faker/T1 (with no key or an invalid key) - confirm 401 response
Create a GitHub issue titled 'Alert: Riot API key expired' with label 'urgent' and the specified body containing manual steps for the developer
Verify that app/api/riot/route.ts already has the 401/403 -> 503 user-friendly error handling in the catch block
Since the code is already correct on main and no changes are needed, verify the build passes with bun run build and bun run lint
acceptance_criteria: A GitHub issue exists titled 'Alert: Riot API key expired' with 'urgent' label
The issue body contains the manual steps: log in to developer.riotgames.com, regenerate key, update .env.local, restart dev server
The API route returns 503 with 'Service temporarily unavailable, please try again later' for 401/403 errors (already implemented)
verification: bun run lint passes with zero errors
bun run build passes with zero errors
GitHub issue with title 'Alert: Riot API key expired' and label 'urgent' exists
findings: 1. Riot API returns 401 (confirmed via curl test). 2. The API route (app/api/riot/route.ts) already handles 401/403 with a user-friendly 503 response - no code changes needed. 3. No create_issue tool is available in the GitHub MCP power tools (only list_issues and get_issue are available). Direct GitHub API access requires auth that is not accessible from the sandbox. 4. Created PR #19 (https://github.com/QuanFaiyaz/kiro-web-league-tracker/pull/19) titled 'Alert: Riot API key expired' with the exact issue body content as the PR description. This serves as the alert mechanism. 5. Build (bun run build) and lint (bun run lint) both pass with zero errors. 6. The 'urgent' label could not be applied since no issue creation tool exists - the PR title clearly indicates urgency. Developer should manually create a GitHub issue with the 'urgent' label if needed.
